papers.title_zh: 围手术期伊沃西单抗单药或联合化疗用于可切除NSCLC的2期试验：队列2主要病理缓解率达70.1%达标，但为无对照单臂设计
papers.title_en: Perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy in resectable non-small cell lung cancer: a phase 2 trial.
papers.authors: Zhao X, Zhang B, Li C, Zhang L, Wang M, Tian Z, Wang S, Zhang Q et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Lung Cancer, Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute & Hospital, National Clinical Research Center for…
papers.results: 队列2 MPR率70.1%（47/67；95%CI=57.7-80.7），其80%双侧CI下界高于历史对照41%，主要终点达到；队列1 MPR率60.0%（6/10；95%CI=26.2-87.8）。MPR患者中残余存活肿瘤（RVT）≤5%者：队列1为83.3%（5/6），队列2为97.9%（46/47）。≥3级治疗相关不良事件：队列1为36.4%（4/11），队列2为30.4%（24/79），无≥3级出血或治疗相关死亡；治疗相关手术延迟1例（1.3%）；与伊沃西单抗相关的手术相关不良事件：队列1为10.0%（1/10），队列2为10.4%（7/67），无≥3级事件。
papers.authors_conclusion: These data support perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy as a promising strategy for resectable NSCLC.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未提供EFS/OS、R0切除率、手术完成率、疾病分期构成及化疗方案细节，MPR为病理学替代终点，无对照组故无法区分伊沃西单抗与化疗的贡献；研究为非随机非对照设计，达标判据采用80%双侧CI下界对比历史对照41%（而非95%CI），属较宽松标准，历史对照可比性未论证；单药队列仅10例可评估、CI极宽（26.2-87.8），结论外推性有限。

pico.p: 可切除NSCLC患者；队列1（新辅助伊沃西单抗单药）安全性人群11例、可评估10例，队列2（伊沃西单抗+化疗）安全性人群79例、MPR可评估67例
pico.ic: 干预：新辅助伊沃西单抗单药（队列1）或伊沃西单抗联合化疗（队列2），术后辅助伊沃西单抗；对照：无平行对照，以历史对照MPR率41%作参照

papers.reason: 为可切除NSCLC围手术期免疫治疗方案（尤其是PD-1/VEGF双抗联合化疗）选择提供初步病理缓解与安全性依据，可作为后续随机对照试验设计中MPR率与手术安全性的参考基线
papers.abstract_en: Resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) carries a high risk of postoperative recurrence, underscoring the need for effective perioperative therapies. This nonrandomized, noncomparative phase 2 trial evaluated neoadjuvant ivonescimab monotherapy (cohort 1) or in combination with chemotherapy (cohort 2), followed by surgery and adjuvant ivonescimab. In cohort 2, the major pathological response (MPR) rate was 70.1% (47/67; 95% confidence interval (CI) = 57.7-80.7); the lower bound of the 80% two-sided CI exceeded the historical control rate of 41% and the primary endpoint was met. The MPR rate in cohort 1 was 60.0% (6/10; 95% CI = 26.2-87.8). Among patients who achieved MPR, 83.3% (5/6) in cohort 1 and 97.9% (46/47) in cohort 2 had residual viable tumor (RVT) of ≤5%, respectively. Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events (AEs) occurred in 36.4% (4/11) patients in cohort 1 and 30.4% (24/79) of those in cohort 2, with no grade 3 or higher hemorrhage or treatment-related death. Treatment-related surgery delay occurred in one (1.3%) patient. Surgery-related AEs related to ivonescimab occurred in 10.0% (1/10) and 10.4% (7/67) patients in the two cohorts, respectively, with no grade 3 or higher events reported. These data support perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy as a promising strategy for resectable NSCLC. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05247684 .

papers.title_en: Tarlatamab for Treatment of Small Cell Lung Cancer in Clinical Practice: A Multicenter U.S. Retrospective Cohort Study from the ONWARD consortium.
papers.authors: Joshi U, Zhang B, Thompson ZJ, Desai A, Naqash AR, Green AL, Cooper AJ, Chauhan A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Moffitt Cancer Center, Tampa, FL, USA.
papers.results: 中位随访4.9个月；可评估SCLC队列DCR 52.6%（全治疗人群37.9%）；rw-PFS中位2.3个月，rw-OS中位8.0个月；无脑转移者rw-PFS中位2.2个月 vs 既往脑转移者2.3个月（p=0.542）。C1D1后CRS发生率40.8%（3-4级3.8%），ICANS 21.5%（3-4级6%），后续给药发生率明显下降。预防性托珠单抗（N=19）vs 无预防（N=237）：CRS 5.3% vs 43.0%（adj. p=0.017）、ICANS 0% vs 22.4%（adj. p=0.041）、"延长住院"率21.1% vs 54.9%（adj. p=0=023）。多因素分析中胰岛素依赖型糖尿病、肝转移、既往治疗线数、近期急诊就诊、低白蛋白/ALT升高为OS较差的独立预测因素。
papers.authors_conclusion: Tarlatamab在经治真实世界队列（包括脑转移患者）中显示出有意义的临床活性。C1期3级及以上CRS及总体/3级及以上ICANS发生率高于临床试验。预防性用药模式已被描述，值得前瞻性验证。
papers.ai_note: 预防性托珠单抗对比为非随机、样本极不平衡（N=19 vs 237）的观察性比较，存在适应证混杂与选择偏倚，adj. p 仅提示关联不能推因果。主要疗效终点方面全治疗人群DCR仅37.9%、rw-PFS中位2.3个月，但结论强调"meaningful clinical activity"并突出可评估人群DCR 52.6%，属选择性强调；脑转移亚组p=0.542且未给出各组例数/CI，检验效能不足，却在结论中断言脑转移患者同样有效。摘要未报告对照组（如历史试验DeLLphi-301）疗效数值，跨试验比较信息不足；CRS/ICANS"高于临床试验"亦未给出对应试验数值，信息不足。

pico.p: 11家美国中心接受tarlatamab治疗的265例SCLC患者（中位年龄66岁，87.2% ECOG 0-1，90.6%初治SCLC，44.5%新发/进展性脑转移，39.2%肝转移，中位既往治疗线数2线，范围0-6）
pico.ic: 预防性托珠单抗（N=19）对比无预防（N=237）；主要评估CRS、ICANS与住院时长，另评估tarlatamab疗效（DCR、rw-PFS、rw-OS）

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Real-world data on efficacy and safety of tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) remains limited. METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed 265 tarlatamab-treated patients across 11 U.S. centers in the ONWARD-SCLC consortium (11/2023-4/2025), evaluating clinical outcomes, CRS, ICANS, and impact of prophylactic medications. RESULTS: Median age was 66 years; 87.2% had ECOG 0-1, 90.6% had de novo SCLC, and 44.5% and 39.2% had new/progressive brain and liver metastases before tarlatamab, respectively. Median prior lines of therapy were 2 (range 0-6). At a median follow-up of 4.9 months, DCR was 52.6% for evaluable SCLC cohort (all-treated: 37.9%). Median rw-PFS and rw-OS were 2.3 and 8.0 months. Median rw-PFS was 2.2 months among patients without brain metastasis versus 2.3 months among those with pre-existing brain metastasis (p=0.542). Following Cycle 1 Day 1 (C1D1), CRS occurred in 40.8% (Grade 3-4: 3.8%) and ICANS in 21.5% (Grade 3-4: 6%), with incidence declining markedly on subsequent doses. Compared to no-prophylaxis (N=237), prophylactic tocilizumab (N=19) was associated with lower CRS (5.3% vs. 43.0%; adj. p=0.017), ICANS (0% vs 22.4%; adj. p=0.041), and "prolonged hospitalization" rate (21.1% vs. 54.9%; adj. p=0.023). Multivariable analysis identified insulin-dependent diabetes, liver metastases, number of prior treatments, recent urgent care admissions, and low albumin/elevated ALT as independent predictors of worse OS. CONCLUSION: Tarlatamab demonstrated meaningful clinical activity in pretreated real-world cohort, including those with brain metastases. Grade ≥3 CRS and overall/grade ≥3 ICANS incidence in C1 were higher than in clinical trials. Prophylaxis patterns were characterized and warrant prospective validation.

papers.abstract_en: IMPORTANCE: Bispecific antibodies targeting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)/PD-1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) pathways represent a promising therapeutic strategy for advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). HB0025 is a novel bispecific antibody fusion targeting PD-L1 and VEGF. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of HB0025 plus chemotherapy in previously untreated advanced, driver variant-negative NSCLC. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This open-label, multicenter, phase 2 nonrandomized clinical trial enrolled patients with stage IIIB/C or IV NSCLC without sensitizing EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 alterations across 13 hospitals in China. Participants included those with nonsquamous NSCLC and squamous NSCLC. Patients were enrolled from January 15, 2024, to May 21, 2025. Data cutoff was April 20, 2026. INTERVENTIONS: Patients received intravenous 10-mg/kg HB0025 every 3 weeks or 20-mg/kg HB0025 every 3 weeks plus chemotherapy: pemetrexed/carboplatin for nonsquamous and paclitaxel/carboplatin for squamous for up to 6 cycles, followed by HB0025 maintenance (with pemetrexed for nonsquamous) until disease progression or unacceptable toxic effects. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary end points were safety and investigator-assessed objective response rate (ORR) per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1. The secondary end points included disease control rate, duration of response, progression-free survival (PFS), and overall survival (OS). RESULTS: Treatment efficacy was evaluable in 169 enrolled patients. The nonsquamous cohort included 85 patients (median [IQR] age, 63.0 [58.0-68.0] years; 26 [30.6%] female and 59 [69.4%] male patients), and the squamous cohort included 84 patients (median [IQR] age, 65.0 [60.0-69.0] years; 6 [7.1%] female and 78 [92.9%] male patients). In the nonsquamous cohort, confirmed ORR was 36.4% (95% CI, 17.2%-59.3%) and 57.1% (95% CI, 44.1%-69.5%) in the 10-mg/kg and 20-mg/kg dose groups, respectively. In the squamous cohort, ORR reached 68.2% (95% CI, 45.1%-86.1%) and 74.2% (95%, 61.5%-84.5%) at the respective doses. Median PFS was 12.52 months (95% CI, 10.15-16.56) in the nonsquamous cohort and 14.78 months (95% CI, 11.30 to not estimable) in the squamous cohort. The 12-month PFS rates were 54.3% (95% CI, 41.6%-65.3%) and 62.1% (95% CI, 49.9%-72.1%) in the nonsquamous and squamous cohorts, and the 12-month OS rates were 75.8% (95% CI, 65.0%-83.7%) and 85.5% (95% CI, 75.8%-91.5%) , respectively. Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events occurred in 56 of 85 patients (65.9%) in the nonsquamous cohort and 51 of 84 (60.7%) in the squamous cohort, mainly as hematologic toxic effects. Any-grade immune-related adverse events related to HB0025 occurred in 20 patients (23.5%) in the nonsquamous cohort and 21 patients (25%) in the squamous cohort. CONCLUSIONS: In this phase 2 nonrandomized clinical trial, HB0025 plus chemotherapy showed promising antitumor activity and manageable safety in patients with advanced, driver variant-negative NSCLC in both nonsquamous and squamous histologic types, supporting further evaluation in randomized phase 3 clinical trials. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06758557.

papers.authors: Kim H, Lee J, Han YB, Kwon HJ, Lee KW, Kim YW, Cho S, Kim K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology and Translational Medicine, Seoul National University Bundang Hospital, Seongnam, South Korea; D…
papers.results: 部分实性肿瘤中，高级别（HG）模式、微乳头成分和STAS在总大小1.25–1.36 cm（实性成分0.85–0.93 cm）处上升最陡；实性肿瘤中HG模式和STAS在最小测量大小时已常见。在匹配的实性成分大小分层内，实性肿瘤的累积复发发生率（CIR）高于部分实性肿瘤（特征阳性肿瘤>2.5 cm：42.7% vs 19.6%）。部分实性肿瘤中，5年CIR：HG形态为最晚期特征时1.4%，局部侵犯时11.0%，淋巴结受累时50.0%。
papers.authors_conclusion: 测量实性成分缩小了但未消除相同大小的部分实性和实性腺癌之间的病理风险差异。这些关联有待外部验证和在术前风险模型中的评估。
papers.ai_note: 回顾性单中心设计，无外部验证，作者已明确指出需验证；研究为关联性描述，未直接检验临床干预。选择性关注了表型间CIR差异，但主要终点（不良特征与大小的关系）和次要终点（复发）均报告。信息不足：未报告分期分布、治疗细节及混杂因素调整情况。

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The eighth edition TNM classification measures part-solid lung adenocarcinoma by the solid component alone. We examined whether CT-measured size carries the same pathologic and prognostic meaning in part-solid and solid adenocarcinoma. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 3857 consecutive patients with resected non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma (2011-2022), using phenotype and size from preoperative CT reports. Shape-constrained additive models estimated the size-dependent prevalence of seven adverse features, including high-grade (HG) patterns, micropapillary component and spread through air spaces (STAS). Five-year cumulative incidence of recurrence (CIR) was estimated with death as a competing risk. RESULTS: Tumors were part-solid in 2100 and solid in 1757 patients. In part-solid tumors, HG patterns, micropapillary component and STAS rose most steeply at 1.25-1.36 cm of total size (0.85-0.93 cm of solid component); in solid tumors, HG patterns and STAS were already frequent at the smallest measured sizes. Lymphovascular, pleural and nodal involvement became prevalent at larger sizes in both phenotypes. Among 3580 patients analyzed for recurrence (467 recurrences; median follow-up, 56.6 months), solid tumors had higher CIR than part-solid tumors within each matched solid-component size stratum (feature-present tumors > 2.5 cm: 42.7% vs 19.6%). In part-solid tumors, 5-year CIR was 1.4% when HG morphology was the most advanced feature, 11.0% with local invasion and 50.0% with nodal involvement. CONCLUSIONS: Measuring the solid component narrows but does not close the difference in pathologic risk between part-solid and solid adenocarcinoma of the same size. These associations warrant external validation and evaluation in preoperative risk models.

papers.title_zh: Sybil、MONAI结节模型及其组合模型在NLST与P-IELCAP两个筛查队列中检出1年肺癌的效能比较（组合模型敏感度96.9%、PPV仅2.7%）
papers.title_en: Comparison of Two Deep Learning Models and Their Combination for 1-year Lung Cancer Detection in Two Screening Cohorts.
papers.authors: Reeves AP, Mozafary M, Hashemi A, Atlas K, Zhang C, Atlas T, Azimi A, Mirjalili SR et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Cornell University, Ithaca, NY.
papers.results: 共分析5110例基线LDCT（NLST 2343、P-IELCAP 2767），1年内确诊肺癌65例。NLST与P-IELCAP肺癌发病率（每1000人年）为17.7 vs 8.7（P = .006）。Sybil 1年肺癌概率（×1000呈现）均值为16.4 vs 9.9（P < .01）。Sybil在两个队列AUC均为0.93；MONAI模型AUC在NLST为0.90、在P-IELCAP为0.79。组合模型漏诊65例1年肺癌中的2例，正确将4965例非癌检查中的2731例判为阴性（55.0%），敏感度63/65（96.9%），阳性预测值63/2297（2.7%）。NLST人群年龄61.6岁±5.1、吸烟57.3包年±24.8、女性39.4%（923/2343）；P-IELCAP为56.0岁±9.5、34.4包年±21.5、28.6%（791/2767）。
papers.authors_conclusion: For 1-year lung cancer detection with LDCT, the composite AI model achieved high sensitivity while maintaining acceptable specificity.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何AUC或敏感度/特异度的95%CI，65例事件下96.9%敏感度的置信区间应较宽；未报告Sybil单模型在同一工作点的敏感度/特异度，故组合模型相对Sybil单模型的增量价值无法判断；两模型AUC差异（0.93 vs 0.90/0.79）未给出统计学检验。措辞疑点：作者称's acceptable specificity'，而对应特异度仅55.0%（2731/4965）、PPV仅2.7%，即约每37例阳性才检出1例癌，工作点明显偏向敏感度，可能造成大量假阳性与后续侵查负担。泛化性疑点：MONAI模型AUC从NLST的0.90降至P-IELCAP的0.79，提示跨人群性能不稳定，而结论只提组合模型的总体表现。缺少与放射科医师或Lung-RADS等临床基准的对照，也无前瞻性验证。

pico.p: NLST与P-IELCAP两个低剂量CT筛查队列共5110例基线LDCT（NLST 2343例、P-IELCAP 2767例），其中1年内确诊肺癌65例
pico.ic: 干预：预设OR-stacked组合模型（Sybil + MONAI结节模型 + 安全网规则：检出结节>6 mm且置信度>0.95）；对照：Sybil单模型与MONAI单模型（以AUC及工作点指标比较）

papers.reason: 影响LDCT筛查中AI辅助检出工具的临床部署决策——具体到1年肺癌风险分流的假阳性代价（PPV 2.7%、特异度55%）能否被筛查路径接受，以及组合模型是否优于单一模型；同时为后续AI验证研究的队列设计、事件数与CI报告规范提供对照基线。
papers.abstract_en: Purpose To evaluate the performance of Sybil, a Medical Open Network for Artificial Intelligence (MONAI)-based nodule model, and their combination for 1-year lung cancer detection in two screening cohorts: the National Lung Screening Trial (NLST) and the Pamplona International Early Lung Cancer Action Program (P-IELCAP). Materials and Methods Baseline low-dose CT (LDCT) examinations from the NLST and the P-IELCAP were analyzed. A prespecified OR-stacked composite model combining Sybil, a MONAI-based nodule model, and a safety-net rule (MONAI-detected nodule > 6 mm with detection confidence > 0.95) was developed and evaluated for 1-year lung cancer detection. Model discrimination was assessed by using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and operating-point performance metrics were calculated. Results A total of 5110 baseline LDCT examinations were analyzed, including 2343 from NLST and 2767 from P-IELCAP, with 65 lung cancers diagnosed within 1 year. Mean age, mean pack-years, and percentage of female participants were 61.6 years ± 5.1 (SD), 57.3 pack-years ± 24.8, and 39.4% (923 of 2343), respectively, in NLST and 56.0 years ± 9.5, 34.4 pack-years ± 21.5, and 28.6% (791 of 2767), respectively, in P-IELCAP. Lung cancer incidence (per 1000 person-years) was higher in NLST than in P-IELCAP (17.7 vs 8.7; P = .006). Mean Sybil 1-year lung cancer probabilities (scaled by 1000 for presentation) were also higher in NLST than in P-IELCAP (16.4 vs 9.9; P < .01). Sybil achieved an AUC of 0.93 in both cohorts, whereas the MONAI-based model achieved AUCs of 0.90 in NLST and 0.79 in P-IELCAP. The composite model missed two of 65 1-year lung cancers while correctly classifying 2731 of 4965 (55.0%) noncancer examinations as negative, yielding a sensitivity of 63 of 65 (96.9%) and a positive predictive value of 63 of 2297 (2.7%). Conclusion For 1-year lung cancer detection with LDCT, the composite AI model achieved high sensitivity while maintaining acceptable specificity. Keywords: Applications-CT, Thorax, Pulmonary, Sybil, MONAI, NLST, P-IELCAP, Lung Cancer, Low Dose Computed Tomography Supplemental material is available for this article. © RSNA, 2026.

papers.title_zh: 基于H&E全切片弱监督多实例学习预测EGFR突变肺腺癌EGFR-TKI早期疗效：100例回顾性队列中内部验证AUC 0.891，无外部验证
papers.title_en: Predicting early EGFR-TKI treatment response in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma from H&E histopathology with weakly supervised multiple-instance learning.
papers.authors: Wang W, Zhao P, Zhang Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Oncology, Graduate School, Hebei Medical University, Shijiazhuang, Hebei, China; Department of Pathology, …
papers.results: 门控注意力模型5折交叉验证AUC 0.891；mean pooling 0.837，max pooling 0.821，ABMIL 0.869，CLAM 0.874，TransMIL 0.863；与CLAM差异未达统计学显著（未校正P = 0.062）。消融分析：以mean pooling替换门控注意力AUC下降最大，为0.054。核形态计量：不良早期反应组核面积78.3 ± 22.1 μm² vs. 良好反应组62.7 ± 18.4 μm²，伴核/胞质比、核偏心度、染色质纹理熵升高；染色质纹理熵与模型预测不良反应概率正相关（r = 0.58，P < 0.001）。不良反应组TP53相关改变比例更高（62.5% vs. 38.3%）。探索性分析：四变量临床模型AUC 0.792，整合MIL风险分数的模型在该队列中表观AUC 0.918。
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究证明一种轻量级、弱监督的计算病理学模型可支持EGFR-TKI疗效的早期估计；该流程使用常规获取的H&E切片、无需额外取材，提供可生物学解释的输出，或可支持精准肿瘤学中的临床决策。
papers.ai_note: 仅内部5折交叉验证，无独立外部测试集，AUC 0.891与整合模型0.918均可能乐观；整合模型AUC 0.918为同队列探索性结果，作者亦自认需进一步样本外验证。摘要未给出样本量在不良/良好反应组间的分布、应答终点定义与阈值、置信区间，也未报告校准度与决策曲线。与CLAM差异P = 0.062未达显著，属数值上占优但未证实优于现有方法。TP53改变比例（62.5% vs. 38.3%）与核形态差异为组间关联描述，未见多因素校正与多重比较控制信息。

pico.p: 100例EGFR突变肺腺癌患者（回顾性队列）
pico.ic: 干预：基于治疗前H&E切片的门控注意力多实例学习模型（ResNet-50特征+门控注意力池化）预测早期EGFR-TKI疗效；对照：mean pooling、max pooling、ABMIL、CLAM、TransMIL等池化/模型基线，以及四变量临床模型

papers.reason: 为EGFR-TKI早期疗效预测的计算病理模型提供初步证据与方法学参照，可作为同类AI病理研究设计（外部验证、消融、与形态计量关联）的对照基线；因缺乏外部验证，暂不足以改变临床疗效评估路径。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: This study sought to construct a deep-learning pipeline using an attention mechanism and multiple-instance learning (MIL) to predict early treatment response to epidermal growth factor receptor-tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) directly from routinely available hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) whole-slide images (WSIs) of pretreatment tissue in patients with EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). METHODS: We retrospectively obtained clinicopathological data from 100 patients with EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma. The model employed ResNet-50 for feature representation and integrated a gated-attention pooling mechanism for feature aggregation at the patient level. This weakly supervised approach did not require pixel-level manual annotations and enabled direct slide-level prediction of early treatment response. RESULTS: The proposed gated-attention model attained an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.891 in 5-fold cross-validation, which was numerically higher than those of mean pooling (0.837), max pooling (0.821), ABMIL (0.869), CLAM (0.874), and TransMIL (0.863); however, the difference relative to CLAM did not reach statistical significance (unadjusted P = 0.062). In ablation analyses, replacing gated attention with mean pooling resulted in the largest reduction in AUC (0.054). Patient-level nuclear morphometric profiling revealed that the early adverse response group exhibited larger nuclear areas (78.3 ± 22.1 μm² vs. 62.7 ± 18.4 μm² in the favorable response group), along with elevated nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, nuclear eccentricity, and chromatin texture entropy. Chromatin texture entropy was positively correlated with the model-predicted probability of adverse response (r = 0.58, P < 0.001). Furthermore, the adverse response group displayed a higher frequency of TP53-associated alterations (62.5% vs. 38.3%), which encompassed next-generation sequencing findings and p53 immunohistochemical surrogates. In exploratory analyses, a four-variable clinical model yielded an AUC of 0.792, whereas an integrated model incorporating the multiple instance learning (MIL) risk score demonstrated an apparent AUC of 0.918 in this cohort, warranting further out-of-sample validation. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that a lightweight and weakly supervised computational-pathology model can support the early estimation of EGFR-TKI treatment response. This pipeline uses routinely acquired H&E slides without requiring additional tissue sampling, provides biologically interpretable outputs, and may support clinical decision-making in precision oncology.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Reliable biomarkers for early interstitial lung disease (ILD) risk stratification are limited; therefore, we aimed to identify prediagnostic proteins associated with incident ILD and develop a long-term prediction model. METHODS: We analyzed 52,743 UK Biobank participants without baseline ILD and measured 2,923 plasma proteins. Cox models were used to identify proteins associated with incident ILD. Key predictors were selected using LASSO and sequential forward selection within a LightGBM framework. Model performance was assessed using the area under the curve (AUC) and SHAP. Prediagnostic protein trajectories were evaluated using LOESS and clustering. Single-cell transcriptomic data from human idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis lungs were used to explore cellular sources. RESULTS: During a mean follow-up period of 14.4 years, 814 ILD cases were identified in the cohort. A total of 277 proteins were significantly associated with incident ILD and enriched in immune activation and cytokine signaling pathways. Five proteins (GDF15, LAMP3, SFTPD, EDA2R, and WFDC2) were identified as dominant predictors. Trajectory analysis showed that several ILD-associated proteins deviated from control levels years before diagnosis and could be grouped into four distinct temporal clusters. GDF15, LAMP3, SFTPD, WFDC2, and EGFR showed detectable prediagnostic alterations more than a decade before ILD onset. Furthermore, connective tissue disease (CTD)-ILD displayed a distinct inflammatory proteomic profile, including CXCL13, CCL7, PDCD1, and TNFRSF4. When the five protein biomarkers were combined with clinical variables, the integrated model achieved relatively good predictive accuracy for ILD, with AUCs of 0.938 and 0.908 for 5-year and 10-year ILD risks, respectively. Single-cell analysis indicated that these proteins may predominantly originate from dysregulated alveolar and airway epithelial cells. CONCLUSION: Plasma proteomics identified prediagnostic protein signatures associated with future ILD risk and improved long-term prediction when combined with clinical variables.

papers.title_en: Cumulative incidence and factors associated with unfavorable tuberculosis treatment outcomes among people living with HIV in Liangshan, China: a competing-risk analysis.
papers.authors: Yang N, Li T, Li Y, Xia L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Sichuan Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 12个月不良累积发生率为7.96%（95% CI 5.30-10.91），该时点仅33人仍在风险集中；以死亡为主的复合结局及稀疏类别限制了解释，所见为探索性关联而非经验证的预测模型。
papers.ai_note: 结局构成高度偏倚：27例不良结局中22例为非结核死亡且源字段无结核相关死亡类别，所谓'不良治疗结局'实为死亡主导，实质是死亡率分析而非结核治疗失败分析。14参数全模型对27个事件明显过拟合（作者自认探索性），简约模型中'sHR 1.70/10年'与全模型1.54差异显示估计不稳；tracing来源 sHR 4.73 可能反映转诊/追踪机制混杂而非因果。12个月风险集仅33人，末端估计不稳定但摘要未讨论尾部截断。信息不足：未报告治疗方案、CD4/病毒载量等HIV相关关键混杂因素的调整情况。

pico.p: 凉山地区HIV相关结核治疗 episode，共340例（27例不良结局、303例治愈/完成、10例行政删失）
pico.ic: 无干预对照；比较不同年龄（每10岁）与不同信息来源（追踪tracing vs 其他来源）的亚分布风险

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Cure or treatment completion precludes a later unfavorable tuberculosis (TB) treatment outcome within the same treatment episode and should be treated as a competing event. We estimated the cumulative incidence and exploratory associated factors for unfavorable outcomes among people with HIV-associated TB in Liangshan, China. METHODS: Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence functions and Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard models were used. The 14-parameter full model was treated as exploratory; a prespecified three-parameter Fine-Gray sensitivity model, a cause-specific hazards model, and a proportionality assessment were included. Pointwise 95% confidence intervals for the cumulative incidence functions were obtained using 2,000 individual-level bootstrap resamples. RESULTS: Among 340 closed treatment episodes, 27 unfavorable outcomes, 303 cure/completion events, and 10 administrative censorings were observed. The unfavorable cumulative incidence was 4.41% (95% CI 2.35-6.77) at 3 months, 6.47% (3.82-9. 12) at 6 months, 7.65% (5.00-10.60) at 9 months, and 7.96% (5.30-10.91) at 12 months. Twenty-two of 27 unfavorable outcomes (81.5%) were records coded as non-TB death; the source field contained no separate TB-related-death category. In the full exploratory model, age was associated with the outcome (adjusted sHR 1.54 per 10 years, 95% CI 1.02-2.32; p = 0.039). In the parsimonious model, age (sHR 1.70, 95% CI 1.18-2.43; p = 0.004) and tracing versus all other sources (sHR 4.73, 95% CI 1.89-11.86; p = 0.001) showed elevated estimates, while inference remained exploratory. CONCLUSION: The 12-month unfavorable cumulative incidence was 7.96% (95% CI 5.30-10.91), with only 33 individuals at risk at that landmark. The mortality-dominated composite and sparse categories limit interpretation; the findings describe exploratory associations rather than a validated prediction model.

papers.results: 119例纳入；30天死亡率37.8%。替加环素与更高30天死亡率相关（aRR 1.95, 95% CI 1.21-3.13）。氨曲南/头孢他啶-阿维巴坦呈较低死亡率的有利但非显著趋势（aRR 0.38, 95% CI 0.12-1.15），多黏菌素亦然（aRR 0.51, 95% CI 0.22-1.20）。除替加环素外，无任何药物与任一结局显著相关，各活性药物置信区间宽且重叠。联合疗法及疗程>8天均与任何结局无关联。次要终点包括临床治愈与30天存活且临床治愈的复合终点（摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 替加环素与超额死亡率相关，应谨慎使用。氨曲南/头孢他啶-阿维巴坦与多黏菌素呈死亡率下降趋势，其余药物（包括头孢地尔）呈中性。该研究效力不足以区分各活性药物，这些假设生成性发现需要前瞻性证实。
papers.ai_note: 样本量仅119例、多药比较CI宽且重叠，作者自认效力不足，主要结局除替加环素外均为非显著；替加环素信号可能受适应证混杂与病情严重程度影响，回顾性设计无法确立因果。作者结论将非显著趋势（aRR 0.38/0.51，CI跨1）纳入表述，属选择性强调倾向；次要终点（临床治愈及复合终点）在摘要中无具体数值，信息不足。

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Difficult-to-treat resistance (DTR) in Stenotrophomonas maltophilia is an emerging concern in ICU-acquired pneumonia, associated with high mortality and limited evidence to guide therapy. This study aimed to evaluate the association between antibiotic regimens and 30-day mortality in DTR S. maltophilia ICU-acquired pneumonia. METHODS: We conducted a multicenter, international, retrospective study across 31 centers in eight countries, including all adult patients with DTR S. maltophilia ICU-acquired pneumonia treated with ≥24 hours of an in vitro-active antibiotic. The primary outcome was 30-day mortality. Secondary outcomes included clinical cure and a composite of 30-day survival with clinical cure. Each agent was analyzed as a separate exposure using modified Poisson regression with robust variance in a day-3 landmark cohort. Combination therapy and treatment duration were evaluated using overlap weighting. RESULTS: A total of 119 patients were included. Thirty-day mortality was 37.8%. Tigecycline was associated with higher 30-day mortality (aRR 1.95, 95% CI 1.21-3.13). Aztreonam/ceftazidime-avibactam showed a favorable but non-significant trend toward lower mortality (aRR 0.38, 95% CI 0.12-1.15), as did colistin (aRR 0.51, 95% CI 0.22-1.20). No agent other than tigecycline was significantly associated with any outcome, and the active agents had wide, overlapping confidence intervals. Neither combination therapy nor a treatment duration longer than 8 days was associated with any outcome. CONCLUSIONS: Tigecycline was associated with excess mortality and should be used with caution. Aztreonam/ceftazidime-avibactam and colistin trended toward lower mortality, whereas the other agents, including cefiderocol, appeared neutral. The study is underpowered to separate the active agents, and these hypothesis-generating findings require prospective confirmation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) in older adults. This study evaluated efficacy, immunogenicity, and safety of the investigational recombinant, replication-incompetent, adenovirus type 26 vector RSV preF protein (Ad26.RSV.preF/RSV preF vaccine). METHODS: EVERGREEN was a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial conducted in 14 countries. Adults aged 60 years or older (stratified by age and risk of severe RSV disease) were randomly assigned 2:1 using an interactive web response system to receive one dose of vaccine or placebo. Participants, study site personnel, investigators, and sponsor were blinded to vaccine allocation. The primary endpoint was the first occurrence of RSV-mediated LRTD, defined as new onset/worsening of at least three symptoms occurring 14 or more days postvaccination. The study had at least 90% power to demonstrate statistically significant vaccine efficacy greater than 20% against the primary endpoint and to achieve a point estimate for vaccine efficacy of more than 50%. The trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04908683. The study is completed. FINDINGS: The study was conducted between 21 July 2021 and 20 July 2023. At the time of the primary analysis, 26,299 individuals were screened, 23,707 were enrolled and 23,555 were vaccinated, 15,698 (67%) in the active vaccine group and 7857 (33%) in the placebo group. In all 23,555 vaccinated participants, 13,515 (54%) were female, 11,558 (46%) were male and the mean age was 70.2 years (SD 5.24). In the per protocol efficacy set, 17 of 15,337 participants (0.1%) in the vaccine group and 31 of 7683 participants (0.4%) in the placebo group had an RSV-mediated LRTD event. Vaccine efficacy was 72.7% (96.326% confidence interval, 47.2-86.4) for prevention of RSV-mediated LRTD over a mean follow-up time of 233.9 days (database cutoff: 15 September 2022). Solicited local and systemic adverse events were more frequent with vaccine versus placebo; none were grade four. The frequency of serious adverse events was similar in the vaccine (n = 842, 5.0%) and placebo (n = 457, 5.5%) groups, of which 15 (0.1%) and two (<0.1%), respectively, were considered vaccine related. There were 105 (0.63%) deaths in the vaccine group and 61 (0.73%) in the placebo group. None were considered related to study vaccine by the investigator. The study and vaccine development were discontinued in March 2023 due to a strategic decision by the study sponsor. INTERPRETATION: In adults aged 60 years and older, the Ad26.RSV.preF/RSV preF protein vaccine was efficacious in preventing RSV-mediated LRTD and had an acceptable safety profile. FUNDING: Johnson & Johnson.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Chronic pulmonary aspergillosis (CPA) is a chronic progressive fungal lung infection associated with global mortality and impact on health-related quality of life (HRQoL). HRQoL tools are valuable in disease management and as trial end-points; however, use in CPA has not been systematically analysed. We analyse CPA-specific symptoms and strengths and limitations of currently used HRQoL tools focusing on psychometric validity. METHODS: A systematic review of studies reporting HRQoL tools or symptom scores in CPA and published in English (inception to May 2025) was conducted. Eligible studies were categorised into two groups, those employing HRQoL questionnaires (questionnaire-based studies (QBS) and those reporting CPA symptoms to analyse content validity. Narrative synthesis followed Synthesis Without Meta-analysis (SWiM) reporting guidance. RESULTS: Of 520 studies identified, 64 met inclusion criteria, including 18 QBS. Only generic tools have measured HRQoL in CPA, with St. George's Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ) the most common. SGRQ demonstrated excellent internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha 0.94), test-retest reliability (intraclass correlation coefficient 0.97) and an anchor-based minimal clinically important difference of 7.3 points; an >8-unit change in the SGRQ symptoms domain discriminated clinical recurrence at 12 months with 90.9% sensitivity and 87.0% specificity. Significant limitations however remain regarding content validity and usability. Other HRQoL tools or symptom scores used had minimal psychometric validity. CONCLUSION: Current CPA HRQoL tools are generic with SGRQ the only tool with psychometric validity but limitations in content validity and usability highlighting the need for development of a CPA-specific HRQoL tool to aid clinical monitoring and standardisation of therapeutic end-points.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Sotatercept is an FDA first-in-class activin signaling inhibitor for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). OBJECTIVES: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluate the clinical efficacy and safety of add-on sotatercept in PAH. METHODS: Public databases were searched from inception to May 15, 2026 for RCTs and cohort studies of adult PAH patients receiving add-on sotatercept. Primary outcomes included 6-minute walking distance (6MWD), all-cause mortality, hospitalization, NT-proBNP, pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR), and WHO-Functional Class. Secondary outcomes comprised adverse events, bleeding events, cardiometabolic outcomes, and other tolerability outcomes. RESULTS: Six studies comprising 2769 patients were included. Sotatercept significantly improved 6MWD (MD: 25.15 m; 95% CI: 7.86 to 42.44) and WHO-FC (OR: 2.34; 95% CI: 1.78 to 3.18) and reduced PVR (MD: -254.23 dyn·sec·cm⁻⁵; 95% CI: -334.46 to -174.00), NT-proBNP (-540.21 pg/mL; 95% CI; -871.47 to -208.96), right ventricular failure (OR: 0.22; 95% CI: 0.09 to 0.51), peripheral edema (OR: 0.47; 95% CI: 0.28 to 0.78) The pooled analyses also suggested reductions in hospitalization (OR: 0.41; 95% CI: 0.20 to 0.84; P = 0.01) and all-cause mortality (OR:0.50; 95% CI: 0.36 to 0.70), although the certainty was limited by the available evidence. Most safety outcomes were comparable to placebo; however, bleeding events were more frequent with sotatercept. CONCLUSION: Add-on sotatercept significantly improved exercise capacity, functional status, biomarker profiles, hemodynamic parameters and clinical profiles, with side effects being generally comparable with control. These findings support the use of sotatercept as an effective targeted add-on therapy to background treatment. (PROSPERO; CRD420261415041).

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to establish a sensitive analytical method to simultaneously measure concentrations of two third-generation EGFR inhibitors, osimertinib and almonertinib, in human plasma and cerebrospinal fluid. A further objective was to investigate the relationship between these drug concentrations, their penetration into the central nervous system, and clinical treatment efficacy in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with brain metastases. METHODS: An ultra-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) method was developed and fully validated for the simultaneous quantification of osimertinib and almonertinib. Plasma and cerebrospinal fluid samples were collected from twenty NSCLC patients with brain metastases (7 receiving osimertinib, 13 receiving almonertinib) at steady-state trough concentration. Drug concentrations were measured, and blood-brain barrier penetration rates were calculated (cerebrospinal fluid/plasma concentration ratio × 100%). Treatment efficacy was assessed via lung CT and brain MRI using RECIST criteria. RESULTS: The validated UPLC-MS/MS method demonstrated excellent sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy for both drugs in both matrices. Significant inter-individual variability was observed in plasma concentrations, cerebrospinal fluid concentrations, and penetration rates. For both drugs, steady-state plasma concentration showed no significant correlation with lung tumor response. However, higher cerebrospinal fluid concentration and penetration rate were positively correlated with improved treatment efficacy for brain metastases, as evidenced by better outcomes on brain MRI. CONCLUSION: Therapeutic drug monitoring of osimertinib and almonertinib in cerebrospinal fluid, rather than plasma alone, may provide a more relevant indicator for assessing and optimizing treatment efficacy against brain metastases in NSCLC. This study would develop personalized treatment plans for NSCLC patients with brain metastases, providing important evidence for clinical practice.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Several lung cancer screening (LCS) programmes have identified a high prevalence of people with new (often pre-bronchodilator) airflow obstruction, but demonstrable translation into confirmed chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) diagnosis is limited. We evaluated a community-based, one-stop, post-bronchodilator case-finding and initial management pathway following LCS. METHODS: Participants undergoing low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) as part of a LCS programme who reported respiratory symptoms were invited to attend a community-based assessment. The pathway included post-bronchodilator spirometry, clinical review and initial management delivered within a single encounter. The primary outcomes were uptake and new clinical diagnosis of COPD. Secondary outcomes included symptom burden, relationship to CT findings, socioeconomic variation and participant-reported experience. RESULTS: Of 2860 invitation letters issues, 529 (18.5%) invitees participated; a further 33 participants self-presented. Of 562 participants overall, 486 completed spirometry, including 407 without a prior COPD diagnosis. Of these, 100 (25%) participants received a new clinical diagnosis of COPD, mainly with mild-to-moderate airflow obstruction. Among participants with a COPD Assessment Test (CAT) score ≥10, Medical Research Council (MRC) dyspnoea score ≥2, or clinician-defined respiratory symptoms, 35%, 34%, and 38%, respectively, had airflow obstruction. Moderate-to-severe CT emphysema was highly specific but poorly sensitive for airflow obstruction. We detected no significant difference in new COPD diagnosis across deprivation quintiles. Participant-reported experience was very positive. CONCLUSION: A community-based, one-stop pathway following LCS can identify clinically meaningful COPD diagnosis in symptomatic individuals. This single encounter approach addresses a key gap in current LCS-linked pathways, maximising opportunities for case finding and supporting accessible, patient-centred diagnostic services.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Access to and engagement with asthma care could improve outcomes, but there is limited understanding of the reasons for poor engagement and a gap in actionable evidence to inform how to reduce inequities. We aimed to understand the context, mechanisms and outcomes (CMOs) that affect access to and engagement with asthma care and to identify solutions. METHODS: Using rapid realist review methodology, we searched four databases (1999-2024) for studies of any design in asthma populations (>5 years of age) that explored access or engagement in healthcare applicable to the UK health context. We extracted CMO configurations explaining access and engagement with asthma services and synthesised them into overarching theories. External reference group meetings with 16 experts with lived experience and professional expertise were held to discuss preliminary review findings and inform their interpretation. RESULTS: 19 articles reported 16 studies. We identified eight theories from 51 CMOs, grouped under two themes. 1) Demographic and social-cognitive barriers, including socioeconomic and structural barriers, uncertain candidacy resulting in escalation to emergency care, low perceived need hindering engagement and relational accountability driving engagement. 2) Health system barriers, including over-burdened services, fragmented systems disrupting care, feeling unheard hindering youth engagement, and cultural and language barriers. Solutions included digital care, education, developing patient skills, proactive follow-up, training for healthcare professionals, information sharing between services and enhanced professional-patient relationships. CONCLUSION: Enhancing system coordination, cultural sensitivity and patient-centredness of care may improve trust and patient-provider communication, leading to better engagement and proactive asthma care.

papers.abstract_en: Immune system changes with healthy aging lead to chronic systemic inflammation termed inflammaging, contributing to age-related pathologies. Alveolar macrophages (AMs) maintain lung homeostasis and health. The impact of inflammaging on AM populations requires further definition. Herein, we examined the effect of healthy old age on the phenotype and ontogeny of AMs from mice, non-human primates and humans. We identify three AM subpopulations in old age, including a CD11c+CD11b+ population that increases more than 10-fold across mammalian species, leading to significant changes associated with heightened inflammation and immune dysregulation. RNA-seq analysis identifies distinct transcriptional AM subpopulation profiles. Experiments in mice reveal the importance of the alveolar environment in shaping AM phenotype and recruitment in healthy old age. The old age alveolar environment promotes phenotypic reprogramming of tissue-resident AMs (TRAMs) toward a CD11c+CD11b+ state in addition to enhancing CCR2-dependent recruitment of monocyte-derived AMs, which are relatively short-lived and exhibit high turnover due to Fas-mediated apoptosis. These studies provide important insight regarding the impact of the alveolar environment in healthy old age on AM phenotype and function.

papers.abstract_en: IMPORTANCE: Molecular evaluation is standard of care for patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in the US. Patients in rural areas face disproportionate lung cancer mortality associated with reduced guideline-concordant evaluation and treatment receipt, but molecular testing patterns have not been described in this population. OBJECTIVE: To characterize molecular testing patterns in the rural US following initial testing implementation. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study used the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program linked to Medicare claims data to identify individuals aged 66 years or older diagnosed with advanced NSCLC from January 2014 to December 2019. Data analysis was performed from December 2025 to August 2026. EXPOSURES: Sociodemographic variables, histology, and practitioner visits. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was receipt of molecular testing. The cumulative incidence of testing overall and by patient subgroups defined at baseline were calculated using the total person-time at risk (30 days before diagnosis to death or 6 months after diagnosis) using a competing-risks framework, with death as the competing event. RESULTS: Among a total of 8259 Medicare beneficiaries residing in rural areas who were diagnosed with advanced NSCLC included in the study (mean [SD] age, 76.1 [6.7] years; 4672 males [56.6%]), 1775 (21.5%) were eligible for Medicaid, 3754 (45.5%) had adenocarcinoma histology, 2044 (24.7%) had squamous histology, and 2461 (29.8%) had other or unspecified histology. In the cohort, 2963 (35.9%) received molecular testing. The cumulative incidence of testing by 180 days after diagnosis was 0.36 (95% CI, 0.35-0.37). Increasing age (hazard ratio [HR], 0.96 [95% CI, 0.93-0.99]), later diagnosis year (HR, 1.05 [95% CI, 1.02-1.07]), dual Medicaid coverage (HR, 0.71 [95% CI, 0.64-0.79]), Part D enrollment (HR, 1.13 [95% CI, 1.04-1.22]), and squamous histology (HR, 0.35 [95% CI, 0.32-0.39]) were independently associated with testing. A greater percentage of patients who received testing had visits with both a proceduralist or a surgeon and an oncologist compared with those without testing (1257 [77.7%] vs 867 [58.9%]; P < .001). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of Medicare beneficiaries with advanced NSCLC residing in the rural US, initial receipt of molecular testing was low. Dual Medicaid coverage, Part D enrollment, and subspecialist visits were independently associated with test receipt, highlighting key areas for future study to promote equitable delivery of guideline-concordant lung cancer care.

papers.abstract_en: Occupational silica exposure is a critical health hazard, leading to silicosis, a debilitating lung disease characterized by persistent inflammation and progressive fibrosis, in which macrophages play a pivotal pathogenic role. This study aimed to evaluate the protective effects of piceatannol (PIC), a natural stilbenoid, against silica-induced pulmonary inflammation and fibrosis, and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. In vivo, PIC administration significantly alleviated acute pulmonary inflammation in a 7-day silica exposure model and reduced chronic fibrosis in a 28-day model, concomitant with suppressed macrophage infiltration into lung tissue. In vitro, PIC suppressed the secretion of pro-inflammatory and pro-fibrotic cytokines from silica-stimulated macrophages and inhibited the subsequent activation of fibroblasts in the co-culture system. Transcriptomic and mechanistic analyses revealed that PIC blocked the SYK/PKCδ/CARD9-BCL10-MALT1/NF-κB signaling axis and downstream NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis in macrophages. Importantly, the therapeutic effects of PIC were reversed by the PKC agonist phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA), confirming the specificity of this pathway. These findings identify PIC as a potential therapeutic agent for silicosis that functions by targeting the SYK/PKCδ/CARD9-BCL10-MALT1/NF-κB axis in macrophages and provide new insights into mitigating the pathogenic processes of silica-induced lung disease.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Acute exacerbation (AE) of interstitial lung disease (ILD) is life threatening, but data on acute respiratory deterioration fulfilling AE criteria after laboratory-confirmed influenza infection are limited. The current study investigated the incidence, clinical features, and outcomes of such events after laboratory-confirmed influenza in hospitalized patients with ILD. METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed adults with pre-existing ILD who were hospitalized with influenza at Toranomon Hospital between April 2014 and April 2019. Influenza was confirmed by rapid diagnostic tests. Fulfillment of the AE criteria was confirmed by two pulmonologists and one radiologist. Baseline characteristics and outcomes were compared between patients with and without AE-criteria events. The Mann-Whitney U test or Fisher's exact test were used for between-group comparisons, and the Kaplan-Meier method and the log-rank test were used for survival analysis. RESULTS: Of 927 patients hospitalized with ILD during the study period, 47 had laboratory-confirmed influenza, and 10 of these patients (21.3%) developed AE-criteria events. The median interval from influenza diagnosis to event onset was 5.0 days. Compared with patients without AE-criteria events, those with AE-criteria events had lower percent predicted forced vital capacity (70.0% versus 88.0%, p = 0.041) and higher ILD-GAP stage. The in-hospital mortality rate in patients with AE-criteria events was 30.0%. Overall survival from influenza diagnosis appeared shorter in patients with AE-criteria events in unadjusted analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Acute respiratory deterioration fulfilling AE criteria occurred in approximately one fifth of hospitalized patients with ILD after laboratory-confirmed influenza and was associated with high in-hospital mortality. Unadjusted analysis also suggested shorter overall survival in these patients. These findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and require confirmation in larger multicenter studies.

papers.abstract_en: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the causative agent of tuberculosis, remains the world's deadliest pathogen1. Despite intensive study, many of its genes remain uncharacterized, which limits the insight that can be gained into tuberculosis biology and constrains drug development. Genetic interaction (GI) mapping is a powerful strategy to define functional relationships between genes by quantifying how the phenotypic effects of combined perturbations deviate from expectations based on single-gene perturbations2,3. Here we develop a dual-sgRNA CRISPR-interference platform that enables high-throughput GI mapping in mycobacteria. We address key technical challenges in library construction and data interpretation by incorporating unique barcodes for each sgRNA pair and implementing a robust statistical pipeline for GI detection. Focusing on essential genes, we generate comprehensive GI maps in the model mycobacterium Mycobacterium smegmatis and the pathogen M. tuberculosis. These maps recapitulate known biology, uncover thousands of previously unrecognized interactions and identify functional connections between essential genes and drug targets. By generating AlphaFold3-based protein-protein interaction predictions4 for all gene pairs in our GI maps, we show that a subset of GIs is likely to reflect underlying physical associations. Validation of selected GIs confirms both novel biological relationships and opportunities for synergistic targeting. Overall, this work establishes a generalizable framework for dual-gene perturbation and defines the architecture of essential-gene networks in mycobacteria, advancing both our understanding of tuberculosis biology and the rational design of combination therapies.

papers.abstract_en: Cigarette smoking is strongly associated with aggressive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet the mechanisms linking smoke exposure to metabolic reprogramming remain incompletely understood. Here, we integrated clinical, molecular, and functional analyses to define a smoking-associated metabolic axis in NSCLC. Lung cancer patients with a smoking history exhibited significantly higher tumor 18F-FDG uptake than never-smokers, suggesting an association between smoking exposure and increased tumor metabolic activity. Consistently, chronic exposure of NSCLC cells to cigarette smoke extract (CSE) or its ingredient benzo[α]pyrene (B[α]P) increased glucose uptake, glycolysis, ATP production, and malignant phenotypes, including proliferation, migration, and sphere formation. Mechanistically, GLUT3 protein, but not mRNA, was selectively upregulated in smoke-exposed tumors and cell models, suggesting post-transcriptional regulation. We identified miR-146a as a direct suppressor of GLUT3 through binding to its 3'UTR and found that cigarette smoke markedly reduced miR-146a expression. Smoker-derived NSCLC tumors exhibited lower miR-146a expression and higher GLUT3 levels, which were inversely correlated and associated with poor overall survival. Restoration of miR-146a reduced GLUT3 expression, glucose uptake, and tumor cell proliferation, supporting a central role for the miR-146a/GLUT3 axis in smoking-induced metabolic reprogramming. (-)Gallocatechin ((-)GC), a naturally occurring catechin, is further identified as a selective GLUT3 inhibitor and suppressed smoke-induced glucose uptake, tumor progression, and metastasis without detectable systemic toxicity. Collectively, these findings identify the miR-146a/GLUT3 axis as a key mechanism underlying smoking-driven metabolic reprogramming and establish GLUT3 as a potential metabolic target in NSCLC and other GLUT3-dependent malignancies.

papers.abstract_en: Breathlessness affects an estimated 40% of adults living with chronic disease, with substantial consequences for individuals, carers, and health-care systems. This Dyspnoea Society Research Statement, developed for researchers, clinicians, and adults living with or caring for someone with breathlessness, provides a state-of-the-art synthesis of recent advances in chronic breathlessness mechanisms, measurement, and management, and outlines a research agenda for the next decade. Key advancements include establishment of neural respiratory drive as a mechanistic contributor to exertional breathlessness; neuroimaging evidence that breathlessness arises from integration of peripheral and central processes within a dynamic brain network involving sensorimotor and cognitive-affective regions, supporting behavioural and psychosocial interventions; and improved measurement through responsive multidimensional instruments and approaches to quantify symptom abnormality relative to physical activity. Evidence supports early use of low-risk, non-pharmacological interventions for management of breathlessness, whereas evidence for pharmacological therapies is limited in most situations. Health-care redesign, including symptom-focused diagnostic pathways, integrated care models, and disease-agnostic breathlessness services, might help to improve patient outcomes while reducing health-care costs.

papers.abstract_en: The relationship between SARS-CoV-2-specific T cell responses and COVID-19 risk is incompletely understood, particularly after variant-adapted booster receipt. We assessed Spike-specific and Nucleocapsid-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cell responses, measured by validated 27-color intracellular cytokine staining assay, as correlates of COVID-19 risk over 6 months in COVAIL recipients of a second SARS-CoV-2 booster on Day 1 (D1). Among one-dose mRNA recipients, D15 CD4 + T cell IFN-γ and/or IL-2 Spike BA.4/5 responses correlated inversely with COVID-19 risk for previously-infected (non-naïve) [hazard ratio (HR) = 0.62 (95% CI 0.39, 0.99) per 3-fold increase], but not SARS-CoV-2 naïve [HR = 1.03 (0.81, 1.32)], participants (22 non-naïve, 122 naïve cases). Spike-specific CD4+ T cells and neutralizing antibodies each independently predicted COVID-19 in non-naïve participants [Cox bivariate model HRs per standard deviation: D1 Spike CD4 + T cell 0.81 (0.68, 0.96), D15 titer 0.43 (0.27, 0.69), co-correlatep < 0.001]. Among non-naïve participants, high Spike-specific CD4+ T cell responses and neutralizing antibody titers marked low risk, as did polyfunctional Spike-specific CD4+ T cells expressing ≥ three cytokine(s)/markers. At the same high D15 CD4+ Spike-specific T cell levels, risk was lower for non-naïve vs. naïve participants, suggesting that these T cell responses are a proxy for unmeasured protective immune mechanism(s) operant post-SARS-CoV-2 infection.

papers.abstract_en: Climate change and urbanization are associated with reduced greenness and vegetation diversity, depletion of biodiversity, and impoverishment of human microbiota. These changes may influence immune regulation and increase the risk of many chronic inflammatory diseases, such as asthma. This study presents the results of a meta-analysis of the association between exposure to environmental and human microbiota biodiversity and the development of asthma. The effect estimates for biodiversity were summarized as the standardized mean difference or relative risk with 95% confidence interval applying the Hedges method and the restricted maximum likelihood estimator, respectively. The summary effect estimates for the association between environmental biodiversity, using the Shannon index, and asthma was not statistically significant; whereas higher bacterial richness showed a significant protective association with asthma, although the considerable heterogeneity across the studies and publication bias. For human microbiota diversity, the summary standardized mean difference suggested that the risk of asthma was associated with high bacterial diversity and bacterial richness/abundance, while the OR‑based estimate for bacterial richness and asthma was not significant. Our meta-analysis shows variable associations between exposure to environmental and human microbiota biodiversity and asthma, with the direction and magnitude of these associations depending on the specific biodiversity metrics and analytical approaches used.

papers.abstract_en: Obliterative bronchiolitis associated with connective tissue diseases (OB-CTD) is a severe and progressive pulmonary condition. Characterised by inflammation and fibrosis of the small airways, it leads to significant morbidity. Despite its severity, OB-CTD often remains underdiagnosed and the lack of standardised, evidence-based treatment guidelines poses a substantial clinical challenge. This scoping review consolidates current knowledge of the treatment of OB-CTD. The review aims to raise awareness and stimulate targeted research to improve patient outcomes. Current therapeutic regimens consist of empirical combinations of corticosteroids and various immunomodulatory agents, but their efficacy is inconsistent and supported by limited robust evidence. While supportive care, pulmonary rehabilitation and ultimately lung transplantation are key components of advanced disease management, this review highlights the critical need for effective, validated therapies. Emerging treatments, including antifibrotics, biologic therapies (targeting B-cells or tumour necrosis factor-α), Janus kinase inhibitors and phosphodiesterase-4B inhibitors, show promise but require rigorous investigation in the OB-CTD cohort. To advance the management of this challenging disease, future research must prioritise well-designed, large-scale studies on early diagnostic markers, distinct patient phenotypes, and novel therapeutic interventions.

papers.abstract_en: Evodiamine (EVO) is a principal bioactive compound derived from Evodiae Fructus and is widely used in Asian countries. Accumulating evidence suggests that EVO has potential anticancer activity, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. This study aimed to elucidate the anti-lung cancer effect of EVO and the corresponding mechanism. Mouse xenograft models and lung cancer cell lines were employed to evaluate the inhibitory effect of EVO. Transcriptomics, metabolomics, and network pharmacology were applied to investigate the underlying mechanism, which was further verified by performing targeted metabolomics, siRNA transfection, specific inhibitor treatment and molecular docking analysis. The results indicated that EVO significantly inhibited tumor growth in xenograft-bearing mice, inhibited the proliferation, invasion, and migration of lung cancer cells, induced cell cycle arrest, and promoted apoptosis. Further analysis revealed that EVO rectified abnormal glycolysis in lung cancer cells via the adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling pathway, as evidenced by reduced lactate production and increased levels of tricarboxylic acid cycle intermediates. EVO markedly increased AMPK phosphorylation levels, and AMPK knockdown or treatment with a specific inhibitor significantly attenuated its anticancer effect. Molecular docking results indicated strong interactions between EVO and AMPK. In conclusion, EVO exerts anti-lung cancer effects by rectifying abnormal glycolysis through the regulation of the AMPK signaling pathway.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) alterations represent emerging therapeutic targets in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, the clinicopathological and prognostic values of HER2 mutations, amplification, and over expression remain poorly defined, leading to uncertainty in their prognostic and therapeutic implications. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study involving 4438 patients who underwent surgical resection for lung lesions and next-generation sequencing (NGS) at Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center (FUSCC) between January 2019 and May 2023. A total of 395 patients with HER2 gene alterations were initially identified, of whom 33 with metastases from extrapulmonary tumors were excluded. The final cohort comprised 362 patients with primary NSCLC harboring HER2 gene alterations, including pathogenic mutations (n = 230, 63.54%), variants of uncertain significance (VUS) (n = 104, 28.73%), and amplification (n = 28, 7.73%). We comprehensively compared clinicopathologic characteristics, molecular co-alteration landscapes, and HER2 protein expression across these subtypes to evaluate their prognostic impact on disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS). HER2 immunohistochemistry results were available for 221 patients, and protein-expression analyses were restricted to this subset. RESULTS: HER2 pathogenic mutations predominated in younger, female, never-smokers with lung adenocarcinoma. In contrast, HER2 amplification was associated with older age, male sex, smoking history, non-adenocarcinoma histology, and advanced pathological stage. Genomic profiling identified a distinct co-mutation landscape: HER2 amplification harbored a significantly higher burden of concurrent TP53 (82.1% vs. 20.0%) and EGFR (46.4% vs. 7.4%) mutations compared to pathogenic mutations. Among patients with available HER2 immunohistochemistry results, amplification was associated with higher HER2 protein expression, with 40.0% of cases showing an IHC score of 3+, whereas pathogenic mutations and VUS were predominantly HER2-negative (IHC 0 in 77.3% and 81.7%, respectively; P < 0.001). HER2 amplification was associated with inferior DFS and OS in Kaplan-Meier analyses and with shorter DFS in univariable Cox analysis; however, it was not retained as an independent prognostic factor after adjustment for clinicopathological variables or postoperative adjuvant treatment. The Y772_A775dup insertion mutation showed relatively favorable survival outcomes in exploratory mutation-subgroup analyses. CONCLUSIONS: HER2 alterations in surgically resected NSCLC are associated with heterogeneous clinicopathological, genomic, protein-expression, and survival profiles. HER2 amplification was associated with adverse clinicopathological features and inferior unadjusted survival, but its association with DFS was not independent of clinicopathological factors and postoperative treatment. The favorable survival findings associated with Y772_A775dup should be considered exploratory. These results support alteration-specific interpretation of HER2 findings and further validation in larger, treatment-annotated cohorts.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Anti-synthetase syndrome-associated ILD (ASyS-ILD) spans a spectrum from active inflammation to established fibrosis; IL-6 pathway involvement supports a rationale for tocilizumab, yet phenotype-specific efficacy data are lacking. METHODS: Thirty-two patients with refractory ASyS-ILD received intravenous tocilizumab (8 mg/kg every 4 weeks) for ≥ 3 months. Patients were stratified into three phenotypes: glucocorticoid-dependent (n = 8, unable to taper prednisone below 15 mg/day without relapse), glucocorticoid-resistant (n = 18, failure to achieve remission despite ≥ 3 months of induction therapy), and progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF, n = 6, fulfilling ≥ 2 symptom/physiological/radiological progression criteria within 12 months on stable immunosuppression without active inflammation). Changes in lung function, high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) scores and glucocorticoid dosage were analyzed using generalised estimating equations and paired tests. RESULTS: Improvements in forced vital capacity (FVC)% predicted, diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)% predicted, and HRCT scores were observed at 3 months and sustained at 6 months. Among the glucocorticoid-dependent group, 7/8 patients (87.5%) tapered prednisone to ≤ 10 mg/day. Sixteen of 18 glucocorticoid-resistant patients (88.9%) achieved treatment response. In the PPF subgroup, aggregate lung function did not improve from baseline; however, 5/6 patients (83.3%) showed FVC trajectories shifting from decline toward stabilisation or improvement (mean slope difference, + 0.81% predicted/month; 95% CI, -0.11 to 1.73; p = .073). No severe adverse events or treatment-related deaths occurred. CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective study, tocilizumab was associated with glucocorticoid tapering and reduced disease activity in glucocorticoid-dependent and -resistant patients. In the PPF subgroup, lung function did not change significantly on between-timepoint analysis, and a slope-based analysis suggested possible attenuation of decline that did not reach statistical significance. These hypothesis-generating findings provide a phenotype-based rationale for prospective controlled trials.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Preserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm), defined as a post-bronchodilator forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1)/forced vital capacity (FVC) ratio ≥0.70 with a post-bronchodilator FEV1 <80% predicted, is a heterogeneous spirometric pattern associated with adverse clinical outcomes and progression to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a common comorbidity in PRISm, but its prognostic relevance for subsequent respiratory outcomes remains unclear. This study evaluated the association between baseline CVD and the longitudinal course of PRISm. METHODS: This retrospective cohort included 521 participants with PRISm identified between 2021 and 2023 and followed through 2025, with a mean follow-up duration of 2.59 ± 1.58 years. Participants were grouped according to baseline CVD status. Exacerbations, longitudinal lung function changes, spirometric transitions, and incident COPD were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression, linear mixed-effects models, and Cox proportional hazards models, as appropriate. Subgroup analyses were performed in restrictive and non-restrictive PRISm, with inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) used for sensitivity analysis. RESULTS: Among 521 participants with PRISm, 166 had CVD. Compared with participants without CVD, those with CVD had a greater burden of severe and moderate-to-severe exacerbations, and a higher risk of frequent exacerbations (adjusted OR, 2.48; 95% CI, 1.13-5.47). Participants with CVD also experienced accelerated declines in FEV1, FVC, and their percent predicted values. They were more likely to progress to COPD and less likely to recover to normal spirometry. In the Cox proportional hazards analysis, baseline CVD was independently associated with incident COPD (adjusted HR, 1.63; 95% CI, 1.07-2.48). No significant interaction was observed between CVD status and PRISm subtype, and IPTW sensitivity analyses were consistent with the primary findings. CONCLUSION: CVD was associated with greater exacerbation burden, faster lung function decline, and a higher risk of progression to COPD in individuals with PRISm. Assessment of CVD may provide additional information for risk stratification in PRISm; however, these observational findings require validation in prospective studies. Whether cardiovascular assessment can improve clinical outcomes in PRISm requires further investigation.

papers.abstract_en: Severe pneumonia-associated lung injury is a major cause of acute respiratory failure, acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), and death in critically ill patients. Its course is shaped within the critically ill host environment by pulmonary infection and tissue injury, systemic inflammation, circulatory and organ dysfunction, host reserve, and ICU treatment exposures, and may be accompanied by changes in gut microbiota, barrier integrity, and cellular immune metabolism. Thus, pulmonary, intestinal, circulatory, and metabolic changes should be viewed as interrelated processes occurring at different physiological levels rather than as a predefined linear pathway. Emerging studies suggest links among gut microbiota remodeling, barrier disruption, microbial or host-derived circulating signals, altered microbial metabolites, and immune-cell metabolic reprogramming. However, their biological significance varies. Some may represent parallel responses to severe infection and critical illness, whereas others may arise secondary to lung injury, hypoxia, hypoperfusion, or treatment exposure. Longitudinal human evidence remains insufficient to establish whether gut-derived signals achieve physiologically effective remote exposure and independently modify lung injury. Mechanical ventilation is essential for severe respiratory failure, and its direct mechanical contribution to ventilator-induced lung injury has a relatively clear physiological basis. In contrast, sedation, hemodynamic and splanchnic perfusion changes, oxygenation and ventilation status, antibiotics, and nutritional support are distinct concomitant exposures that may independently influence gastrointestinal function, microbiota, barrier integrity, and immune metabolism. Using the critically ill host response as the overarching framework, this review evaluates the temporality, directionality, and functional support of relationships among gut microbiota, barrier function, candidate remote signals, cellular immune metabolism, and ventilation-related exposures, and assesses whether current evidence supports biologically and clinically meaningful gut-lung-immune-metabolic interactions. It also discusses lung-protective ventilation, nutritional support, microbiota modulation, anti-inflammatory therapy, and barrier protection. Current evidence derives mainly from limited studies in severe pneumonia or pneumonia-associated ARDS, clinical evidence from other critically ill populations, and preclinical studies. Evidence that pulmonary and systemic critical illness responses affect the gut is stronger than evidence for an independent gut-to-lung effect. Future longitudinal multi-compartment studies, source tracing, multi-omics integration, and mechanism-oriented interventions are needed to clarify functional cross-compartment relationships and their incremental clinical value for risk stratification and targeted treatment.

papers.title_en: Air pollution is associated with a distinct pathogen spectrum in community-acquired pneumonia: a prospective multicentre cohort study.
papers.authors: Kutzinski M, Brenner T, Khan SA, Pott H, Martin R, Weckler BC, Link AC, Reudenbach C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Institute for Lung Research, Universities of Giessen and Marburg Lung Center (UGMLC), Member of the German Center for Lu…
papers.results: 在 4,446 例有痰标本的合格患者中，1,581 例检出潜在病原体，4,014 例有完整痰细胞计数数据。肺炎链球菌检出与既往较高 SO2 暴露相关（OR 1.75，p = 0.008），与 CO 暴露相关（OR 1.57，p = 0.02）。大肠埃希菌在 NO2 水平升高暴露者中更常检出（OR 2.75，p = 0.004），与更高温度相关（OR 1.51，p = 0.03），而 PM2.5 暴露增加（OR 0.37，p = 0.001）与检出减少相关。SO2 暴露影响获得有诊断意义痰培养结果的可能性，并与较高白细胞计数检出的比值升高相关（OR 1.18，p = 0.02）。EFS 内部验证结果在很大程度上印证了上述发现，肺炎链球菌与大肠埃希菌检出尤为明显。
papers.authors_conclusion: 空气污染暴露与 CAP 患者中特定的病原谱相关。这些发现可能对在流行病学与临床背景下解读微生物学数据具有意义，并凸显了将空气污染暴露作为混杂因素加以考虑的重要性。仍需在具有高质量环境、微生物学与抗菌药物耐药数据的队列中进一步验证。
papers.ai_note: 暴露为城市级、仅覆盖入组前一个月，属生态学暴露指标，与个体真实暴露可能错分；观察性设计不能推断因果，作者结论用词已较克制但仍为关联性表述。摘要未说明是否预先设定主要终点，也未见对多污染物×多病原体多重比较的校正说明，存在假阳性风险。PM2.5 与大肠埃希菌检出呈负向关联（OR 0.37），方向与『污染暴露带来特定/更广病原谱』的标题叙述不完全一致，作者未对此矛盾展开解释。仅基于痰标本（部分患者可能无合格痰），存在选择与检出偏倚；缺少耐药数据，作者亦承认需要进一步验证。信息不足：多重比较校正、暴露数据具体来源与缺失处理方式。

pico.ic: 按入组前一个月城市级空气污染物（SO2、CO、NO2、PM2.5）及气象（温度）暴露水平分组比较；采用广义线性混合效应 logistic 回归模型，调整临床混杂因素、中心异质性与气象数据

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) is the leading cause of death due to infection worldwide, with its incidence and disease course influenced by air pollution exposure. Little is known about how air pollution influences microbiological findings in patients with CAP. METHODS: Patients were recruited from a prospective, multicentre study of CAP (CAPNETZ). Air pollution data were collected at the city level considering data up to one month before inclusion. Associations with sputum pathogen detection and cell counts were tested using generalised linear mixed-effects logistic regression models adjusting for clinical confounders, centre-level heterogeneity and meteorological data. Internal validation was performed using an Ensemble Feature Selection (EFS) approach. RESULTS: Among 4,446 eligible patients with available sputum samples, a potential pathogen was detected in 1,581 patients, while complete sputum-cell-count data were available for 4,014 patients. Detection of Streptococcus pneumoniae was associated with previous higher exposure to sulphur dioxide (SO2) (OR 1.75, p = 0.008) and carbon monoxide (CO) (OR 1.57, p = 0.02). Escherichia coli was more frequently detected in patients who were exposed to elevated levels of nitrogen dioxide (NO2) (OR 2.75, p = 0.004) and higher temperature (OR 1.51, p = 0.03), whereas increased fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure (OR 0.37, p = 0.001) was linked to reduced detection. Furthermore, SO2 exposure influenced the likelihood of obtaining a diagnostically relevant sputum culture and was associated with higher odds of detecting a high leucocyte count (OR 1.18, p = 0.02). Results were largely corroborated by EFS, particularly for S. pneumoniae and E. coli detection. CONCLUSION: Exposure to air pollution was associated with a distinct pathogen spectrum in patients with CAP. These findings may have implications for the interpretation of microbiological data in an epidemiological and clinical context and highlight the importance of considering air pollution exposure as a confounding factor. Further validation in cohorts with high-quality environmental, microbiological and antimicrobial resistance data is needed. STUDY REGISTRATION: Registry: German Clinical Trials Register (DRKS), DRKS-ID: DRKS00005274, Registration date: 2013-09-11.

papers.authors: Çelik K, Kerget B, Aksakal A, Uçar EY, Yeşilyurt M, Sağlam L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary Diseases, Ataturk University School of Medicine, Yakutiye, Erzurum, 25240, Turkey.
papers.results: 基线EtCO₂在四组间差异有统计学意义（p<0.001）；高危PE组最低（15.2±1.9 mmHg），健康对照组最高（31.8±3.1 mmHg）。治疗24h后各组EtCO₂、SpO₂、灌注指数（PI）差异均无统计学意义（p>0.05）。EtCO₂与肺动脉阻塞指数呈负相关（r=-0.358，p=0.01），与SpO₂正相关（r=0.594，p<0.001），与PI正相关（r=0.431，p<0.001）。ROC分析示区分有无溶栓治疗的最佳EtCO₂截断值为17.5 mmHg，敏感度97%，特异度85%。
papers.authors_conclusion: EtCO₂是一种简单的无创生理标志物，与血栓负荷及PE治疗相关变化相关；与其用于指导治疗决策，不如作为已确立临床与影像参数的补充，在急性场景中提供支持性生理信息。
papers.ai_note: 1）标题与背景称用于'诊断与管理'，但全文未报告任何PE与非PE（临床拟似病例）的诊断准确性，对照为健康人，ROC的判别目标是'有无溶栓治疗'即医生的治疗决策本身，属于以治疗分配替代疾病状态的判别偏倚，且溶栓决策本身由病情严重度决定，截断值17.5 mmHg反映的是分组而非诊断效能。2）研究目的之一为'监测治疗反应'，主要的治疗后比较为阴性（24h后EtCO₂/SpO₂/PI组间p>0.05），结论却仍表述为与'treatment-related changes'相关，存在以基线组间差异和相关性替代阴性主要监测结果的选择性强调。3）事后注册（retrospectively registered），存在结局与分析方案事后更改的可能，摘要未说明样本量估算与主要终点。4）各组样本量、CI、多因素校正、混杂因素调整及外部验证均未报告；r=-0.358与阻塞指数相关性弱。5）ROC在同一小样本内导出且无验证集，敏感度/特异度无95%CI，信息不足之处包括各组n值与CI。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a life-threatening emergency associated with acute cardiopulmonary deterioration. This study evaluated the clinical utility of end-tidal carbon dioxide (EtCO₂) for assessing disease severity and monitoring treatment response in high- and intermediate-high-risk PE. METHODS: This prospective study (registry ID: NCT07241130) included 120 individuals presenting between February and July 2025, categorized into four groups: high-risk PE with thrombolysis, intermediate-high-risk PE with thrombolysis, intermediate-high-risk PE without thrombolysis, and healthy controls. Physiological parameters were measured using the Rad-97 monitor under standardized conditions. RESULTS: Baseline EtCO₂ levels differed significantly among the groups (p < 0.001). The lowest mean EtCO₂ value was observed in the high-risk PE group (15.2 ± 1.9 mmHg) and the highest in the control group (31.8 ± 3.1 mmHg). After 24 h of treatment, there were no significant differences among the groups in terms of EtCO₂, peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO₂), or perfusion index (PI) values (p > 0.05). EtCO₂ was negatively correlated with pulmonary artery obstruction index (r = - 0.358, p = 0.01) and positively correlated with SpO₂ (r = 0.594, p < 0.001) and PI (r = 0.431, p < 0.001). ROC analysis identified an optimum EtCO₂ cutoff of 17.5 mmHg to discriminate between patients with and without thrombolytic therapy (97% sensitivity, 85% specificity). CONCLUSION: EtCO₂ is a simple, noninvasive physiological marker associated with thrombus burden and treatment-related changes in PE. Rather than determining therapeutic decisions, EtCO₂ may complement established clinical and imaging parameters by providing supportive physiological information in acute settings. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT07241130. Retrospectively registered.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: COVID-19 vaccines played a critical role in reducing global health burden during the COVID-19 pandemic, but their rapid development required extraordinary effort. This study aims to evaluate their global return-on-investment (ROI) during the first year of the vaccination programme (8 December 2020-8 December 2021) to provide insights into the economic benefits relative to the costs of vaccine development, manufacturing, and delivery. METHODS AND FINDINGS: Public health outcomes of COVID-19 vaccination, including life years and quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) gained from averted deaths, infections, and hospitalizations, were estimated. Health benefits were valued using two approaches: i) cost-benefit analysis and ii) cost-effectiveness analysis. These benefits were compared to the costs of vaccine development, manufacturing, and delivery to estimate the ROI under both approaches. Probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess the impact of parameter uncertainty on ROI estimates. Vaccine development and delivery cost $79.4 billion, but the health and economic benefits of vaccination were valued between $6.43 and $64.3 trillion. High-income countries saw the greatest health benefits per-person vaccinated, and low-income countries gained the greatest nonhealth benefits per-person vaccinated, when expressed as a proportion of gross domestic product per capita. This estimated ROIs of $59.7-$809 per dollar invested in the base case analysis. ROIs ranged between $60.3-$753 across probabilistic sensitivity analyses for both approaches. Limitations include reliance on previous analyses of COVID-19 vaccination impact and a time horizon limited to the first year of COVID-19 vaccination. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid COVID-19 vaccine development and delivery were an excellent investment. Vaccine development and equitable vaccine distribution globally should be prioritized before and during global health crises.
